items.title: Neural dynamics of reconstructing knowledge structure from temporally disordered inputs
items.author: Chunming Lu
items.content: Using behavioral ratings and functional magnetic resonance imaging, this study tracks how learners dynamically reconstruct coherent knowledge from temporally disordered lectures. The posterior cingulate cortex supports structural updating, the precuneus shows later sustained representation, and their coupling predicts immediate learning success.

items.title: Neurodegenerative disease risk associated with gene expression in peripheral monocytes across ancestries
items.author: Mina Ryten
items.content: Multi-ancestry genetic analyses reveal that neurodegenerative disease risk genes act in peripheral monocytes, linking ancestry-associated immune regulation to Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s diseases across ancestries.
